leadText:
Mr. Perfect (Japanese: VSゲノセクトI VS Genesect I), titled VS Genesect I in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 526th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the second chapter of the .

It is subtitled Genesect I (Japanese: ミスター・パーフェクト Mister Perfect) in the VIZ Media translation and Mr. Perfect in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
